# PR-head base-merge outcomes for acme/widget#82 (N=1)

## Aliases and setup legend

**Aliases**
- `ROOT=/work/widget`
- `W=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`
- `A=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`
- `B=bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`
- `E=eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee`

The process cwd never changes. Every command targets `ROOT` or `W` with `-C`.

**Setup (identical in every row)**

| # | Command (`git -C` target) | Result |
|---|---|---|
| S1 | `rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir` | Common dir `ROOT/.git`, so ROOT=`/work/widget`. In done-green the session sits in `.worktrees/other`, which is not adopted. |
| S2 | `ROOT rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` | Empty, so not a submodule. |
| S3 | Name resolution | `<name>=fix-retry`. No overrides, tool or wrapper, so home is `W`. |
| S4 | `ROOT fetch origin` | Succeeds. |
| S5 | `ROOT rev-parse --verify -q A^{commit}`; `ROOT rev-parse origin/fix/retry` | A exists and equals origin/fix/retry. |
| S6 | `ROOT rev-parse origin/main` | B. |
| S7 | Stop checks | `isCrossRepository=false`. `ROOT worktree list --porcelain` shows fix/retry only at `W`. No stop fires. |
| S8 | Provisioning row "home already on headRefName (N=1)": `W status --porcelain` | Empty, so clean and no ask. |
| S9 | `W merge --ff-only origin/fix/retry`; `W rev-parse HEAD` | HEAD = A. |
| S10 | Capture values | `PRE_REWORK_HEAD=A`, `BASE_SHA=B`. There are no MEMBER_HEADS. |
| M | `W merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main` | Outcome varies by row. |
| P | `W merge-base --is-ancestor A HEAD` (after every outcome) | Exits 0. |

**Step 4 report (shared)**

```
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa (clean)
PR: acme/widget#82
Pre-rework head: A
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
<merge record>
```

There is no provenance note because this is not fresh creation.

## Helper legend (conflict rows)

| Step | Action |
|---|---|
| H1 | `W status --porcelain` gives the pre-dispatch snapshot `UU src/retry.ts`. |
| H2 | `W diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` gives `[src/retry.ts]`. |
| H3 | Read the overrides from the base, not the conflicted tree: `ROOT show B:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`. Select a documented file-scoped runner only if `requires credentials` is not `true`. |
| H4 | Dispatch one **fresh foreground** `implementer` with `cwd: W` and `async: false`. Tuple **T** = (`[src/retry.ts]`, `origin/main@B`, `['node --test test/retry.test.mjs']`). |
| H4 contract | Resolve preserving both sides' intent. Run only the supplied scoped commands. Stage with `git -C W add`. Return `done` or `done - contract exception: <why>`. No commits, aborts, or edits outside the list. |
| H5 | Completion checks: `W diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` is empty; `W diff --cached --name-only` contains `src/retry.ts`; `W status --porcelain` delta is contained in `[src/retry.ts]`. |
| H6 | All checks pass: the **orchestrator** runs `W commit --no-edit`, giving HEAD = E. |
| H7 | Any check fails: run `W merge --abort`, record `merge: unresolved - src/retry.ts`, and continue on A. The spec Design opens with eventual Task 1: `merge origin/main and resolve src/retry.ts`. |
| Constraints | On every outcome, constraint reads come from BASE_SHA (per `brainstorming/reference/pr-subject.md`). |
| Exclusions | No other tests, no reviewer, no push. Merge review is left to end-of-flow code review. |

## Outcome rows (delta only)

| Row | Delta | Merge record / continuation |
|---|---|---|
| noop | M reports base already an ancestor. No commit; HEAD stays A. | `merge: no-op - head contains origin/main` |
| clean | M succeeds; this is the first rework commit. | `merge: eeeeeee` |
| done-green | Session cwd stays in `/work/widget/.worktrees/other`; all commands still target `W` and the dispatch `cwd` is `W`. H3 finds the PR gate runner `node --test <files>` with `requires credentials: false`, so T is used. Helper returns `done`. H5 passes, H6 commits, and the scoped command passes. | `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests green` |
| exception-red | Same runner and T. Helper returns `done - contract exception: retry count becomes bounded`. H5 passes, H6 commits, and the scoped command fails in `test/retry.test.mjs`. The exception lands and is named in the spec's `## Rework record` `Changes:`. | `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests red in test/retry.test.mjs: node --test test/retry.test.mjs` |
| failure | Helper returns `done`, but the H5 status delta includes `README.md`, which is outside the list, so containment fails. H7: `W merge --abort` succeeds and HEAD = A. Deferred Task 1 applies. BASE_SHA's `AGENTS.md`, which forbids unbounded retries, is authoritative; the worktree's weakened `AGENTS.md` is ignored. | `merge: unresolved - src/retry.ts` |
| credentials | H3 finds `requires credentials: true`, so SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS = none and the helper runs no tests. H5 passes on a valid staged resolution, and H6 commits. | `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests none run (requires credentials: true)` |
| missing-runner | H3 finds only `npm test`, which is full-suite and not inferred as file-scoped. SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS = none. H5 passes and H6 commits. | `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests none run (no documented file-scoped runner)` |

After the Step 4 report in every row, the unresolved-thread fetch for #82 runs before gather, as the PR-head reference specifies.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved on this case: After still defines M as `merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main`, records no-op/clean/green/red/none-run with specific reasons, dispatches one fresh foreground implementer at W with the exact tuple, has the orchestrator commit --no-edit only after the three completion checks, aborts on the README.md containment failure with deferred Task 1 on A, and keeps BASE_SHA reads authoritative. Two risks to watch: After drops the literal `git -C W` prefix from the helper-legend commands (writing `W diff ...`, `W commit --no-edit`, `W merge --abort` under a header that just says 'Action') and relies on the one-line convention 'Every command targets ROOT or W with -C'; a stricter reader could say the commands no longer *explicitly* use git -C, so keep the Before form (`git -C W ...`) at least for discovery, status, staging checks, commit and abort, or put the `git -C` target in that table's header as the setup table does. Also, the closing sentence about an unresolved-thread fetch before gather introduces an extra tracker step the prompt did not ask for; drop it or keep it clearly outside the preapproval boundary so the boundaries fact isn't read as widened.
